text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-Induced Hyperkinetic Movement Disorder (likely Acute Dystonia or Tardive Dystonia secondary to Risperidone). The clinical picture of new onset involuntary movements in a young patient starting risperidone two months ago is highly suggestive of medication-induced extrapyramidal symptoms. We should proceed with a focused neurological examination and consider switching to an atypical antipsychotic with a lower risk of movement disorders, such as clozapine or quetiapine.
